rule: C0, the unmutated control, runs first and must be GREEN; each mutation must go RED with its own failure line; C11, a proper correction row, must stay GREEN.

controls.mutation: a draft judged twice, no supersedes
failure_lines: J-058: draft #1 judged twice without superseding J-001
J-001: verdict 'MAYBE' is not one of ACCEPT/AMEND/REJECT
J-012: AMEND without saying what is owed

controls.mutation: a draft row names the wrong R1 row
failure_lines: J-001: r1_row R1-999 != the draft's R1-004

controls.mutation: a quoted span is not declared
a declared quote is one character off
failure_lines: J-001: undeclared quotation 'produce evidence the motive was hostile from the start'
J-001: quote 1 NOT VERBATIM at map:just-depressed#long: 'produce evidence the motive was hostile from the star#'

controls.mutation: the drafts file moves by one byte
a relation names one the register lacks
failure_lines: J-046: relation 'HR-01 conditions HR-02' is not stored in register v0_5

coverage: relations judged ['HR-01 conditions HR-02', 'HR-12 independent_of HR-10', 'HR-14 independent_of HR-05'], register v0_5's drafted relations ['HR-11 conditions HR-02', 'HR-12 independent_of HR-10', 'HR-14 independent_of HR-05']

controls.mutation: a committed row is edited in place
failure_lines: append-only: committed row J-001 was edited or removed
